p. p. [मि मा-वा-क्त] 
__1 Measured, meted or measured out. 
__2 Measured off, bounded, defined. 
__3 Limited, measured, moderate, little, scanty, sparing, brief (words &c); पृष्टः सत्यं मितं ब्रूते स भृत्योऽर्हो महीभुजाम् [[

.]] 
__4 Measuring, of the measure of (at the end of comp.), as in ग्रहबसुकरिचन्द्रमिते वर्षे i. e. in 1889. 
__5 Investigated, examined. 
__6 Cast, thrown away. 
__7 Built. 
__8 Established, founded. 
-Comp. 
-अक्षर a. 
__1 brief, measured, short, concise; कथंचिदद्रेस्तनया मिताक्षरं चिरव्यवस्थापितवागभाषत [[

.]] 
__2 composed in verse, metrical. 
(-रा) N. of a celebrated commentary by Vijñāneśvara on Yājñavalkya's Smṛti. 
-अर्थ a. of measured meaning. 
-अर्थकः a cautious envoy. 
-आहार a. sparing in diet. 
(-रः) moderation in eating. 
-द्रुः the sea. 
-भाषिन्, -वाच् a. speaking little or measured words; महीयांसः प्रकृत्या मितभाषिणः [[Śi. 2. 13.]] 
-भुक्त a. moderate in diet. 
-मति a. narrow-minded. 
-व्ययिन् a. frugal, economical.

a. 
__1 Cooking a measured portion, cooking little; [[

f. [मा-मि-क्तिन्] 
__1 Measuring, a measure, weight. 
__2 Accurate knowledge. 
__3 Proof, evidence. 
__4 Determination.

[मिद्यति स्निह्यति, मिद्-त्र, मि-त्र बा] 
__1 The sun; तद्दिनं दुर्दिनं मन्ये यत्र मित्रागमो हि ना [[Subhāṣ.]] 
__2 N. of an Āditya and usually associated with Varuṇa; cf. [[

.]] 
__3 The deity presiding over the part of rectum (गुदस्थान); गुदं पुंसो विनिर्भिन्नं मित्रो लोकेश आविशत् [[

.]] 
-त्रम् 
__1 A friend; तन्मित्रमापदि सुखे च समक्रियं यत् [[

.]] 
__2 An ally, the next neighbour of a king; cf. मण्डल. 
-Comp. 
-अनुग्रहणम् the act of favouring friends. 
-अमित्रम् friend and foe; मित्राऽमित्रस्य चार्जनम् [[

.]] 
-आचारः conduct towards a friend. 
-उदयः 
__1 sun-rise. 
__2 the welfare or prosperity of a friend. 
-उपस्थानम् worship of the sun (part of the morning संध्या). 
-कर्मन्, -कार्यम्, -कृत्यम् the business of a friend, a friendly act or service; मित्रकृत्यमपदिश्य पार्श्वतः (प्रस्थितम्) [[

.]] 
-ध्न a. treacherous. 
-द्रुह्, -द्रोहिन् a. hating a friend, treacherous to a friend, a false or treacherous friend. 
-भम् the अनुराधा constellation. 
-भावः friendship. 
-भेदः breach of friendship. 
-युद्धम् a contest between friends. 
-लाभः 
__1 acquisition of friends, contracting of friendship. 
__2 N. of the first book of the Hitopadeśa. 
-वत्सल a. kind to friends, of winning manners. 
-विन्दः an [Page1269-2] epithet of Agni. 
-विषयः friendship. 
-सप्तमी N. of the seventh day in the bright half of मार्गशीर्ष. 
-साह a. kind or indulgent to friends; स्वैर्दौहित्रैस्तारितो मित्रसाहः [[
Den. P. To be friendly, behave in a friendly manner, act as a friend towards.

a. 
__1 Friendly-minded. 
__2 Winning friends. 
-युः A friend.
Den. Ā. To act as a friend, be friendly.
€1P. To become a friend, make friends with.
Den. P. To treat (one) as a friend.
a. Friendly, relating to a friend.
